description: CENSEIS- Centrifuge and Full-scale Modeling of Seismic Pore Pressures in Sands is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Ekin Gultepe, University of Canterbury (canterbury.ac.nz). Centrifuge and full-scale testing in geotechnical Engineering are very useful tools in modeling soil behavior under different loading conditions, particularly under earthquake loading. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 10 top-level files (TXT, CSV). Its DOI is 10.4231/d3gf0mx4f. Keywords: databases, earthquake engineering, full-scale testing, geotechnical engineering, CENSEIS, seismic pore pressures. Published 2015-01-30. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
